overviewParagraphs: Royal Long An Golf & Country Club represents a different philosophy in Sir Nick Faldo's design portfolio — one centred on environmental integration and sustainability. Located in Long An Province, the course was designed to work with the existing wetland and agricultural landscape rather than imposing a manufactured golf environment onto it.

The result is a layout of genuine natural beauty, where rice paddies, wetlands, and mature vegetation frame the holes throughout the round. The course design rewards strategic thinking and precise iron play, with Faldo's signature emphasis on properly positioned approach shots to reach short-sided pin positions.

An excellent complement to the more dramatic southern Vietnam courses, Royal Long An appeals to golfers who appreciate refined design over visual spectacle, and who want to experience a genuinely different style of championship golf just south of Ho Chi Minh City.

curatorBriefHtml: Royal Long An Golf & Country Club is a premier Par 72 championship layout in Long An, Vietnam, crafted by Sir Nick Faldo (2023) and stretching to 7,090 Yards across a parkland, water features environment. In Asia Golf Specialists' (AGS) field evaluations, the course stands out for its natural delta waterway hazard strategy (Water comes into play cleverly) and immaculate green surfaces & roll (True, fast-rolling surfaces).

From an itinerary-engineering perspective, Royal Long An Golf & Country Club (Resort & Visitor Access via AGS) requires advance flight allocation and experienced local caddie pairing—particularly during the peak Vietnam dry season. Our curatorial scorecard specifically notes its caddie wind & carry reading (Prevents penal water miscues), making pre-reserved morning tee times and private door-to-clubhouse VIP transfers essential for maintaining pace of play.

When integrated into a multi-round Long An golf tour by AGS, Royal Long An Golf & Country Club provides a distinct architectural test by Sir Nick Faldo that complements neighboring regional layouts while keeping daily hotel-to-tee transfer times streamlined.
